text: せいぎかんが　つよくて　ねっけつで　かっこよくて　いちばん　すごい　ひと…！

structure.jp: せいぎかんが　つよくて
structure.en: with a strong sense of justice, and

structure.jp: いちばん　すごい　ひと…！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: Changing い to くて (or adding で after a noun-like word) means 'and', letting you string descriptions together. つよくて = 'strong, and...'.
